panels.title: UMF document · metadata
panels.text: sales.id and sales.status are required string Fields.

panels.title: Record and ordered Key
panels.text: sales.order contains both Fields. Its primary Key pk contains sales.id.

panels.title: Module extension
panels.text: sales.extensions → umf.actions → approve declares the permitted status assignment.

panels.title: Separate business data
panels.text: An example stored order has id order-1 and status pending. It is not a row inside the UMF document.

panels.title: Library · browser-compatible
panels.text: Read a document. Register vocabulary. Inspect and compare declarations. No authentication or business writes.

panels.title: Explicit interpretation
panels.text: Compile supported rules/selectors. Evaluate rules only with supplied state. This is separate from inspection.

panels.title: Consumer · host-only
panels.text: Authenticate principal and service. Authorize. Freeze identities. Execute and verify under the native transaction boundary.

panels.title: Qualification boundary
panels.text: Declared compatibility is not execution verification. Inspection does not invoke the consumer or access storage.

panels.title: First request token · business change
panels.text: Before: pending. Required SET: approved. Commit retains the outcome and one business-change fact.

panels.title: Fresh request token · business no-op
panels.text: Before: approved. SET verifies no-op. A new outcome persists; business version and event count do not advance.

panels.title: Original request token · replay
panels.text: Return the exact retained first outcome under current authorization. Do not execute again or substitute the fresh no-op.

panels.title: 1 · create
panels.text: Create the order at an explicit Key. Save the effect identity create; no computed or allocated identifier.

panels.title: 2 · link-customer
panels.text: Source is created:create. Target is the existing customer parameter, using the authored relationship orientation.

panels.title: 3 · link-product
panels.text: Source is created:create. Target is the existing product parameter. Forward references would refuse.

panels.title: Permissions are separate
panels.text: The frozen write frame must permit create and these relationships. Effects require the actual operations; permission alone does not.

panels.title: Client → consumer
panels.text: Send original token, revision, typed inputs and expected versions. Trusted context supplies actor identity.

panels.title: Consumer → native store
panels.text: Commit business changes, verification and terminal outcome atomically. Then the acknowledgement is lost.

panels.title: Client knowledge · indeterminate
panels.text: Unknown whether commit occurred. Timeout does not prove rollback. Keep the original request; do not mint a fresh token.

panels.title: Client → protected lookup
panels.text: Current discovery and original-result authorization gate lookup. Return the retained original outcome; lookup never executes.

panels.title: Missing or expired
panels.text: Missing after uncertainty is not permission to reexecute. No-key requests lack keyed recovery guarantees.

panels.title: Write transaction · commit
panels.text: Business change + terminal outcome + outbox fact commit together. Receipt carries store, epoch and opaque version.

panels.title: Delivery · position 2 arrives first
panels.text: Position 1 is missing. Complete applied prefix stays 0. A larger received position proves no visibility.

panels.title: Projection · position 1 then 2
panels.text: Apply exact facts in order. Update read content and contiguous prefix atomically. Repeated delivery is deduplicated.

panels.title: Read at least the receipt
panels.text: Visible only for the matching store/epoch and qualified content through that complete prefix; otherwise pending or unsupported.

panels.title: Restore boundary
panels.text: Rotate visibility epoch and fence uncertain restored state. Epoch rotation does not erase old replay identity or authorize retry.

panels.title: Isolated handler
panels.text: No raw SQL connection, database credentials, ambient network or broad host mount. Only declared transaction capabilities.

panels.title: Controlled gateway
panels.text: Freeze canonical identities. Check every attempted read/write before storage access. Returning state to its old value cannot hide an attempt.

panels.title: Consumer-owned transaction
panels.text: Authorization, native invariant checks, replay ledger and outbox are control responsibilities. Their reads are not handler permissions.

panels.title: Commit or rollback
panels.text: Verify outputs, constraints, frame and postconditions. Failure aborts the whole attempted transaction; no partial business outcome.

panels.title: Incomplete property
panels.text: post.stock = pre.stock − quantity is insufficient by itself. This is a handler example, not the approve recipe.

panels.title: Counterexample · quantity zero
panels.text: Stock can remain unchanged and the equation still holds. A promised reservation might also be absent.

panels.title: Corrected obligations
panels.text: Require positive quantity, exact stock relation, nonnegative stock, reservation existence and the correct entity identities.

panels.title: Scope of the evidence
panels.text: Model bounds and assumptions are explicit. Actual native refinement and implementation mutants are separate witnesses; none proves every deployment.
